coverage.storyTitle: As a Warehouse Operator, I can pack consignments into insulated containers
As a Warehouse Operator, I can assign a container to a vehicle
As a Delivery Driver, I can collect consignments and follow my assigned route
As a Delivery Driver, I can capture a signature from the receiving Pharmacist at each stop
As a Compliance Officer, I can reconstruct the full temperature history of any batch after the fact
As a Regional Manager, I can review performance across facilities each month
As a system, I continuously receive and ingest container temperature readings
As a system, I detect and alert when a container goes outside its permitted range
As a Delivery Driver and duty Compliance Officer, I am notified immediately when a container alert is raised
As a system, I quarantine an affected consignment when an alert is raised and record it in the audit trail
As a Delivery Driver, I can use the mobile application in areas with unreliable coverage
As an operator, I can view all active routes on the Dispatch Board
As an operator, I can reassign a stop on the Dispatch Board
As a user, I can view live container readings by facility on the Temperature Dashboard
As a Compliance Officer, I can export a batch's history using the Audit Console
As the platform, I integrate with the ERP, mapping provider, SMS gateway, and drug registry to support dispatch and delivery
As a user, I can rely on the Temperature Dashboard to show near-real-time data quickly
As a platform operator, I can depend on the system remaining available during delivery hours
As a Compliance Officer, I can trace every consignment state change to the named user who made it
As a Pharmacist, I only see data belonging to my own pharmacy

sprint.goal: Pharmaceutical deliveries are packed, tracked, temperature-monitored, and audited end to end, with drivers, operators, managers, and compliance officers each able to act on live and historical data.

velocityAssumption.basis: assumed, not measured: this project has delivered no sprint yet, so this is a planning placeholder to divide the work against rather than a team's observed rate

proposed.title: As a Warehouse Operator, I can pack consignments into insulated containers

acceptance.given: a consignment ready for dispatch
acceptance.when: a Warehouse Operator packs it into an insulated container
acceptance.then: the consignment is recorded as contained within that container

proposed.title: As a Warehouse Operator, I can assign a container to a vehicle

acceptance.given: a packed container awaiting transport
acceptance.when: a Warehouse Operator assigns it to a vehicle
acceptance.then: the container shows that vehicle as its assigned carrier

proposed.title: As a Delivery Driver, I can collect consignments and follow my assigned route

acceptance.given: a driver arriving at the warehouse with an assigned route
acceptance.when: they collect the consignments for that route
acceptance.then: each consignment is marked collected and linked to the driver's route

acceptance.given: a driver underway with an assigned route
acceptance.when: they proceed through the planned stops
acceptance.then: the route's stop sequence is available to the driver in order

proposed.title: As a Delivery Driver, I can capture a signature from the receiving Pharmacist at each stop

acceptance.given: a driver has arrived at a stop with a consignment for that pharmacy
acceptance.when: the receiving Pharmacist signs for the delivery
acceptance.then: a signature record is stored against that consignment and stop

proposed.title: As a Compliance Officer, I can reconstruct the full temperature history of any batch after the fact

acceptance.given: a batch that has completed its delivery journey
acceptance.when: a Compliance Officer requests its temperature history
acceptance.then: every recorded reading for that batch's container across the journey is returned in chronological order

backlog.title: As a Regional Manager, I can review performance across facilities each month

acceptance.given: a completed calendar month of deliveries across facilities
acceptance.when: a Regional Manager opens the monthly performance review
acceptance.then: performance figures are shown broken down by facility for that month

backlog.title: As a system, I continuously receive and ingest container temperature readings

acceptance.given: a container sensor operating in transit
acceptance.when: the sensor reports a temperature reading
acceptance.then: the reading is stored as a TemperatureReading linked to that container

acceptance.given: a stream of readings arriving from multiple containers
acceptance.when: the Temperature Monitoring Service ingests them
acceptance.then: each reading is persisted with its container id and timestamp

backlog.title: As a system, I detect and alert when a container goes outside its permitted range

acceptance.given: a container with a defined permitted temperature range
acceptance.when: an ingested reading falls outside that range
acceptance.then: the container is flagged as out of range

acceptance.given: a container flagged as out of range
acceptance.when: the out-of-range condition is detected
acceptance.then: an Alert is created and linked to that container's consignment

backlog.title: As a Delivery Driver and duty Compliance Officer, I am notified immediately when a container alert is raised

acceptance.given: an alert raised for a container assigned to a driver's vehicle
acceptance.when: the alert is created
acceptance.then: the assigned driver receives a notification without manual polling

acceptance.given: an alert raised for any monitored container
acceptance.when: the alert is created
acceptance.then: the duty Compliance Officer receives a notification without manual polling

backlog.title: As a system, I quarantine an affected consignment when an alert is raised and record it in the audit trail

acceptance.given: an alert raised against a consignment's container
acceptance.when: the Quarantine Service processes the alert
acceptance.then: the consignment is marked quarantined and blocked from delivery

acceptance.given: a consignment that has been quarantined
acceptance.when: the quarantine action completes
acceptance.then: an AuditRecord exists showing the quarantine event, its reason, and timestamp

backlog.title: As a Delivery Driver, I can use the mobile application in areas with unreliable coverage

acceptance.given: a driver on a route with intermittent network coverage
acceptance.when: they use the mobile application to view route or delivery details
acceptance.then: the application continues to function using locally available data and syncs once connectivity returns

backlog.title: As an operator, I can view all active routes on the Dispatch Board

acceptance.given: multiple routes currently in progress
acceptance.when: an operator opens the Dispatch Board
acceptance.then: all active routes and their current status are displayed

backlog.title: As an operator, I can reassign a stop on the Dispatch Board

acceptance.given: an active route with an unfulfilled stop
acceptance.when: an operator reassigns that stop to a different route or driver
acceptance.then: the stop appears on the new route and no longer on the original one

backlog.title: As a user, I can view live container readings by facility on the Temperature Dashboard

acceptance.given: containers reporting readings at a given facility
acceptance.when: a user opens the Temperature Dashboard for that facility
acceptance.then: the current readings for that facility's containers are displayed

backlog.title: As a Compliance Officer, I can export a batch's history using the Audit Console

acceptance.given: a batch with recorded history
acceptance.when: a Compliance Officer requests an export from the Audit Console
acceptance.then: a downloadable file containing that batch's full history is produced

backlog.title: As the platform, I integrate with the ERP, mapping provider, SMS gateway, and drug registry to support dispatch and delivery

acceptance.given: a consignment being prepared for dispatch
acceptance.when: the Stock Integration Service queries the ERP
acceptance.then: current stock levels for that consignment's items are returned

acceptance.given: a route awaiting optimisation
acceptance.when: the Route Service calls the mapping provider
acceptance.then: an optimised stop sequence is returned for that route

acceptance.given: a driver notification that needs to be sent
acceptance.when: the Alerting Service dispatches it via the SMS gateway
acceptance.then: the driver receives the notification as an SMS message

acceptance.given: a batch number entered before dispatch
acceptance.when: the Drug Registry Validation Service checks it against the national registry
acceptance.then: dispatch is allowed only if the batch number is confirmed valid

backlog.title: As a user, I can rely on the Temperature Dashboard to show near-real-time data quickly

acceptance.given: a new temperature reading has been received by the system
acceptance.when: 30 seconds elapse
acceptance.then: the reading is visible on the Temperature Dashboard

acceptance.given: a user navigating to the Temperature Dashboard
acceptance.when: the dashboard is requested
acceptance.then: it finishes loading in under 2 seconds

backlog.title: As a platform operator, I can depend on the system remaining available during delivery hours

acceptance.given: a month of operation during declared delivery hours
acceptance.when: uptime is measured across that period
acceptance.then: the platform was available at least 99.5 percent of that time

backlog.title: As a Compliance Officer, I can trace every consignment state change to the named user who made it

acceptance.given: a consignment undergoing a state change
acceptance.when: the change is applied
acceptance.then: an AuditRecord is created naming the user responsible and is retained for inspection

backlog.title: As a Pharmacist, I only see data belonging to my own pharmacy

acceptance.given: a Pharmacist signed in to view deliveries or consignments
acceptance.when: they browse consignment or delivery data
acceptance.then: only records belonging to their own pharmacy are returned
